name: Fantasy Premier League
description: Explore current Fantasy Premier League players, fixtures, managers, squads, history, and classic league standings.
author: Raynard
samplePrompts: Who are the highest-scoring midfielders in FPL right now, and what does Mohamed Salah's fixture run look like?
Show me the standings of my classic league 314 and tell me how the leader's gameweek 5 squad was set up.
How is FPL entry 12345 doing this season — current rank, points per gameweek, and which chips have they played?

tools.name: fpl_get_game_overview
tools.description: Get the overall state of the Fantasy Premier League game: total player/team counts, the current and next gameweek with deadlines, and average scores. Use this first to discover which gameweek is live before calling gameweek-specific tools like fpl_list_fixtures or fpl_get_entry_picks.

tools.name: fpl_search_players
tools.description: Search FPL players by name and/or filter by team and position, sorted by total points. Returns a card with candidate player ids, prices, form and points — use the ids with fpl_get_player for full stats, fixtures and history.

tools.name: fpl_get_player
tools.description: Get a full profile for one FPL player: season stats (points, goals, assists, xG/xA, price, ownership), upcoming fixtures with difficulty ratings, recent gameweek-by-gameweek returns and past-season history. Find the player_id with fpl_search_players first.

tools.name: fpl_list_fixtures
tools.description: List Premier League fixtures for one gameweek (or every fixture when no gameweek is given), with a card showing scores, kickoff times and difficulty ratings. Returns fixture ids and team ids for follow-up calls. Use fpl_get_game_overview to find the current gameweek number.

tools.name: fpl_get_entry
tools.description: Get an FPL manager's team overview: team name, manager name, overall points and rank, latest gameweek points, squad value, bank balance and classic leagues entered. The entry_id is the number in a team's FPL URL, or found in league standings via fpl_get_league_standings.

tools.name: fpl_get_entry_history
tools.description: Get an FPL manager's season history: points, rank, squad value and transfers for every gameweek, plus past-season finishes and chips played. Use for rank-trajectory and chip-strategy questions about an entry_id (from fpl_get_entry or league standings).

tools.name: fpl_get_entry_picks
tools.description: Get an FPL manager's squad for one gameweek: starting XI, bench order, captain and vice-captain (resolved to player names), active chip, points scored and transfer cost. Entry ids come from fpl_get_entry or fpl_get_league_standings; gameweeks from fpl_get_game_overview.

tools.name: fpl_get_league_standings
tools.description: Get the standings table for a classic FPL mini-league: rank, team name, manager, gameweek points and total points, 50 entries per page. Entry ids in the result feed fpl_get_entry, fpl_get_entry_history and fpl_get_entry_picks for head-to-head analysis.
